micro_stamp_initial:
Create a MICRO PIXEL STAMP as a square raster image: EXACTLY 7 columns by7 rows of UNIFORM HUGE SQUARE PIXELS covering entire image, no margin, no grid lines, no text. This is a precision tiny7x7 game-book glyph, not an illustration. Render the following7x7 matrix literally, each character is ONE solid square of its mapped color, never render letters. Matrix rows:
..aaa..
.a.N.a.
a.T.T.a
a.TCT.a
aT...Ta
.NT.TN.
..aaa..
Color mapping: dot '.' = dark brown leather #261F18, a = dark teal #248B9B (complete circular outer ring), T = cyan #46CAD5 (triangle edge), N = pale cyan #A4EDEF (three corner nodes), C = pale cyan #A4EDEF (one center point). The result is a pixel ring enclosing triangular outline with a visible one-cell gap at center of its base. Do not smooth, interpolate, paint, texture, bevel, shade or add details. Exactly49 solid pixel squares, no antialiasing. Square background opaque dark brown, all cells fill edge to edge. No additional border. This is the micro-resolution of the provided scheme A, but the matrix is authoritative.
